grader.scenario: Overseas roaming spend cap blocking bank SMS 2FA codes while travelling in Dubai
grader.notes: Poor customer service call featuring agent rudeness, victim-blaming regarding roaming spend caps, deflection of ownership, failure of empathy regarding business traveler vulnerability abroad, and repeated questioning in the last third of the call.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net international roaming customer care' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Imogen throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
